name: Sister Magic!
source:
The main character lives with his three younger sisters, Haruna, Nano and Nonomi. They don't care about him, so they often walk around the house without clothes or come into bathroom while he is bathing. He is confused by their demeanors and suddenly starts having a dream of a girl who taunts him without notice.

One day, the girl in his dream - whose name is Nerisu - suddenly appears. According to her, she is a princess of the devil world and he is a prince. This means he is the one who will take over the throne. He soon finds out that his three sisters are aware that they are actually descendants of a magician. 

There is only one way to stop him taking over the throne: If one of three sisters gets pregnant with his baby, he won't have the need to do so. The sisters soon curse him to not to be able to ejaculate without them. A fierce battle for him and his babies now breaks out...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主角与他的三个妹妹：榛名、奈奈、野诺美住在一起。他们不关心他，所以经常光着身子在房子里走来走去，或者在他洗澡的时候走进浴室。他对他们的举止感到困惑，突然开始梦见一个女孩在没有注意到的情况下嘲笑他。

有一天，他梦中的女孩——名字叫奈里斯——突然出现。按照她的说法，她是魔界的公主，他是魔界的王子。这意味着他将是继承王位的人。他很快发现他的三个姐妹知道她们实际上是魔术师的后裔。

只有一种方法可以阻止他继承王位：如果三个姐妹中的一个怀上了他的孩子，他就没有必要这样做。姐妹们很快就诅咒他没有她们就无法射精。他和他的孩子们的一场激烈战斗现在爆发了……

[来自工口游戏商店]
